selectdata.scope: Use the task row selectors, or use all rows when disabled.

field.scope: Selected field names, IDs and expressions.

spw.scope: Spectral window selection. The fit mask is controlled by fitspw.

combine.scope: Correlation, scan, field and state combination switches.

timebin.scope: Timestamp counts and quantities with duration units.

slidetimebin.scope: Sliding windows and block processing, including incomplete edge bins.

chanbin.scope: Whole spectral windows, channel counts, and frequency quantities.

minsamp.scope: Minimum number of unflagged samples in each fitted bin.

statalg.scope: Classical, Chauvenet, fit-to-half, and hinges-and-fences selection.

fence.scope: The hinges-and-fences IQR multiplier, including the negative disabled setting.

center.scope: Mean, median, or zero fit-to-half center.

lside.scope: Fit the lower or upper half.

zscore.scope: Fixed limit or sample-size-based Chauvenet criterion.

maxiter.scope: Maximum Chauvenet iteration count and negative convergence setting.

fitspw.scope: Spectral window and channel mask for estimating variances.

excludechans.scope: Invert the fit mask in spectral windows named by fitspw.

wtrange.scope: Inclusive range of allowable weights. Accept the two endpoints in either order.

flagbackup.scope: Capture pre-existing flags before a write. Preview leaves flags and backups intact.

preview.scope: Return the mean and variance of estimated weights without changing the MS.

datacolumn.scope: Raw, corrected and both residual visibility forms, with the corresponding weight or sigma outputs.

behaviors.title: Task and MS tool selection and preview
behaviors.scope: Task and attached MS tool selection, preview, original flag versions, and selected row persistence across ordinary and partitioned MeasurementSets.
behaviors.gap: CASA and native task and tool use matched row sets and read back the same columns and original flag backups.

behaviors.title: Time and channel binning
behaviors.scope: Elapsed duration and timestamp counts, block tails and sliding edge windows, independent channel bins and fit selections, scalar and spectral outputs, and absent or partially defined spectra.
behaviors.gap: Paired summaries and persisted columns meet a 2e-7 relative tolerance. The selected-spectrum creation case follows the recorded decision.

behaviors.title: Variance estimators
behaviors.scope: Classical, Chauvenet, hinges and fences, and fit to half moments with exposure weighting, rejected samples, raw and corrected inputs, and scratch or virtual models.
behaviors.gap: Matched robust and classical estimates, including non-finite output for otherwise eligible zero-exposure samples.

behaviors.title: Persisted weights and downstream calibration
behaviors.scope: Weighted gain solutions and application with scalar or spectral initialization and either calwt value. Casacore readback also covers a 122,880-row spectral write.
behaviors.gap: All four weighted solve and apply chains passed. CPARAM normalized RMS was below 4e-7, corrected visibilities below 5e-7, and weighted application below 8e-7. The 122,880-row spectral write agreed across the native batch boundary.

decisions.inputs: Channel binning on a selected subset without the requested spectrum column.
decisions.casa: Initializes the spectrum and raises; repeating the same selection applies the estimates.
decisions.ours: Initializes the spectrum and applies the requested estimates in one call.
decisions.rationale: The native writer maps the selected rows to the original table after preparing the column.
decisions.impact: One call matches the columns after the CASA retry, with unselected rows retaining the initialized values.

performance.result: The programme will qualify matched release workflows under #979. The local storage profile located and corrected repeated UVW reads during FLAG_ROW persistence.
